what: HIGH (code audit CA-A05-003, MEASURED 2026-09-27): the M28 macro-value sleeve's own most recently committed P4 promotion-gate evidence (comms/macro/thesis_p4_scorecard.json) shows it fails its own promotion bar even at ZERO cost. Scorecard meta: n=1104 scored thesis-entries, 263 rebalance dates, 2005-01-01 to 2026-07-10, 5-symbol universe (GLD, IEF, SLV, SPY, TLT), horizon_days=30, fee_frac=0.0, carry_frac_per_day=0.0 (the most favorable possible cost assumption -- more optimistic than the fee-only corpus CLAUDE.md already flags). Result: calibration_rank=-0.003723 (~0, thesis_conviction has no measurable relationship to net_return) and edge_vs_baseline=-0.004677 (negative -- underperforms a naive all-long baseline by ~47bps mean net return per thesis). The design doc's "Build status: DONE" framing does not surface this verdict, creating a risk that a future session or the daily brief reads "148 tests green" as "this sleeve has edge" when its own P4 evidence says the opposite. The gate itself is functioning correctly -- nothing has been promoted -- this finding is that the doc/evidence link is missing, not that the gate is broken. FIX: pair the design doc's DONE status line with a pointer to this scorecard's verdict (calibration_rank, edge_vs_baseline) so it cannot be read as "has edge". Full finding: docs/audits/code-audit-2026-09-27/CA-A05.findings.jsonl id CA-A05-005.
